Boston Red Sox offseason notes: Red Sox roster moves: Activated Triston Casas, Kutter Crawford, Zack Kelly, Johan Oviedo, Eduardo Rivera, Justin Slaten, and Eli White off the 60-day IL. Then DFA'd Kelly and Rivera. The 40-man roster is at 40.
Reiver Sanmartin: The Giants DFA’d Reiver Sanmartin and declined Rowan Wick’s club option. They now have 40 players on their 40-man roster.
Kenley Jansen: Tigers decline $12 million option on Kenley Jansen, he will hit free agency two saves shy of 500....other moves...

Detroit Tigers offseason notes: Tigers moves: Kenley Jansen’s $12m option declined. He gets a $2m buyout. Drew Anderson’s $10m option picked up. Jacob Waguespack re-signed to a 1-yr, $1.3m MLB contract with another $200k in bonuses based on innings pitched.

Kyren Paris: So Mets DFA Kyren Paris and Cristian Cairo, which I believe means they are back to exactly 40 on the 40-man. Will have to clear room for any additions, but they can figure that out later.
Qualifying offers: Orioles extend $23.15 million qualifying offer to Rogers #Orioles
Isaac Paredes: The Astros exercised Isaac Paredes’ $13.35 million club option.
Jazz Chisholm: What will surely be a fascinating Jazz Chisholm Jr. free agency has begun

Houston Astros offseason notes: The Astros added reliever Roddery Muñoz and catcher César Salazar to the 40-man roster, made their trade for pitcher Evan Reifert official and outrighted Jake Meyers off the 40-man roster. Meyers will elect free agency. Houston’s 40-man roster is at 39 players.

St. Louis Cardinals offseason notes: Cardinals say they officially declined Ryne Stanek’s option and reinstated Max Rajcic. Chase Hampton, who they claimed on waivers a month ago, was claimed by Baltimore. 40-man is at 38.
Philip Abner: Orioles announce they’ve claimed LHP Philip Abner off waivers from the Mets.

Pierson Ohl: The Mets have also claimed righty Pierson Ohl from the Rockies, according to a person familiar with the situation. Ohl was traded to the Rockies after being drafted and developed by, you guessed it, the Minnesota Twins.
Duncan Davitt: The #reds have claimed off waivers RHP Duncan Davitt from the Giants and RHP Paxton Shultz from the Nationals.

Nate Furman: Parker and Tena are probably the most-notable moves here. Parker was going to arbitration-eligible after having TJ surgery in July. Tena was out of options and less defensive value than the just-acquired Nate Furman.
Jake Bauers: Where could Jake Bauers land in free agency after his breakout year? @feinsand.bsky.social takes a look. www.mlb.com/news/jake-ba...

Cameron Weston: Marlins have claimed Cameron Weston off waivers, as @WillSammon mentioned, according to a person familiar with situation. Weston was appealing because his contract situation keeps him under control even if he’s outrighted to the minors, as opposed to becoming a FA tonight.

Ryne Stanek: Today is the 40-man compliance deadline and the official opening of free agency. The Cardinals will have to finalize their decline of Ryne Stanek’s option, as @dgoold.bsky.social reported last night. They also haven’t yet formally activated Max Rajcic from the 60-day IL.

Tony Neubeck: The Nationals announce they've acquired 2B/3B Nat Furman from the Giants for minor-league LHP Tony Neubeck. Furman, 25, played in 22 MLB games this season, going 4-for-32. Lefty hitter slashed .292/.377/.414 at AAA. Has 2 more option years. LHP Richard Lovelady was DFA'd to clear a 40-man spot.
Garrett Whitlock: Red Sox announce they picked up Garrett Whitlock’s $8.25 million team option for 2027.

Aidan Curry: RHP Aidan Curry, who is from Ossining, NY, was set to become a minor free agent, but had his contract selected by the Rangers and was added to the 40-man roster. Originally signed as an undrafted free agent out of high school in 2020 for $20,000.
